events.name: Bash
events.head: Start simulator and local centre on fresh state
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign/cloud; D=$(mktemp -d /tmp/t033v.XXXX); echo $D; SIM_PORT=8893 SIM_STATE=$D/sim.json nohup python3 scripts/vendor-sim.py >$D/sim.log 2>&1 & echo SIMPID=$!; grep -o '"database_name": *"[^"]*"' wrangler.jsonc | head -2; npx wrangler d1 migrations apply $(grep -o '"database_name": *"[^"]*"' wrangler.jsonc | head -1 | sed 's/.*: *"//;s/"//') --local --persist-to $D/state 2>&1 | tail -2; nohup npx wrangler dev --port 8961 --ip 127.0.0.1 --persist-to $D/state --var SIM_URL:http://127.0.0.1:8893 >$D/dev.log 2>&1 & echo DEVPID=$!
